name: Only One 2 ~Bijin Casino Dealer Hitomi~Sei no Roulette~
original_name: オンリーワン2～美人カジノディーラー瞳～性のルーレット～
source:
Hitomi is a №1 card dealer and bartender at the "Testament" casino. One day she hits a man on her car. Man has no injuries, but loses memory upon awakening. Since he has no identification, he gets name "Kenta" and starts to live under the same roof. Eventually Kenta gets attracted to Hitomi and receives a job at the same casino. Soon he becomes aware of the hidden emotions of his everyday life in Testament.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
瞳是“遗嘱”赌场的排名第一的发牌员和调酒师。有一天，她在车上撞到了一名男子。人没有受伤，但醒来后失去了记忆。由于没有身份证明，他取名为“健太”，并开始住在同一屋檐下。最终健太被瞳吸引并在同一家赌场找到了一份工作。很快他就意识到《遗嘱》中他日常生活中隐藏的情感。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
